XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic gear engagement failure, with gearbox fault warning light illuminated.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GEARBOX | CLUTCH | P1810 | NEUTRAL | GEARBOX | ROBOTISED | GEARS | LIGHTS UP | IGNITION | ON | WARNING LIGHT | RED | RED | LEVER | LOCK | CHANGE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Vehicles equipped with robotic gearboxes

  • System: Gearbox

  • Device: Clutch

  • Fault: The gearbox occasionally locks up, preventing the gears from engaging, and the corresponding fault light comes on

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P1810 (Automatic gearbox clutch system - Clutch actuator, clutch position sensor, mechanical fault)

  • Cause: Worn clutch

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the clutch and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The defective component showed visible signs of wear
